description: Defines the RenderableFtlMacroCall class, representing an FTL macro call with builder pattern for parameter setting.

classes.name: RenderableFtlMacroCall
classes.description: Represents an FTL macro call with name and parameters, implements RenderableFtl interface.

classes.name: RenderableFtlMacroCallBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing RenderableFtlMacroCall instances with various parameter types.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a RenderableFtlVisitor to process this macro call.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the macro call.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the map of parameters for the macro call.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for RenderableFtlMacroCall.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Sets the macro call name in the builder.

methods.name: stringParameter
methods.description: Adds a string parameter to the macro call via builder.

methods.name: intParameter
methods.description: Adds an integer parameter to the macro call via builder.

methods.name: booleanParameter
methods.description: Adds a boolean parameter to the macro call via builder.

methods.name: mapParameter
methods.description: Adds a map parameter to the macro call via builder.

methods.name: objectParameter
methods.description: Adds an object parameter to the macro call via builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a RenderableFtlMacroCall instance.

methods.name: parameter
methods.description: Internal method to add a parameter to the parameters map.
